reason: A Telegram integration that provides allowlisted mobile access to local DeepSeek Harness Web sessions, including session attachment, bidirectional chat, context viewing, model switching, and service management.

summaries.zh: 通过 Telegram Bot 为白名单用户提供对本地 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话的移动端附着、双向聊天、上下文查看和模型切换功能。
summaries.en: Provides allowlisted Telegram users with mobile access to local DeepSeek Harness Web sessions for session attachment, bidirectional chat, context viewing, and model switching.

capabilities: Connects to the Telegram Bot API using a configured bot token
Allows allowlisted Telegram users to list, attach to, and chat with local DeepSeek Harness Web sessions
Supports viewing the previous exchange, checking binding status, unbinding the phone, and switching the bound session model
Provides scripts to install the plugin and start, stop, or inspect the local dsh web service
